name: BACH_0362_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (87%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Benign · Careful review
Invasive risk is 1% with clear margins [F7], though blurred frozen-section tissue leaves Benign in the conformal set.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 87%, Benign 9%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 1% [F1] | Low invasive carcinoma risk (1%) |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (α=0.10; 90% dataset coverage) | Cannot separate Normal from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100th percentile OOD, blur severity 3, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Passes QC despite severe blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (80–84% similarity); Benign contrast 73% [F5] | Nearest reference neighbors match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 7, 11) · context · Above-typical score (1.35); descriptive context only [F2] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Scarce score (-0.50, +0.36 contribution) nudges toward invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Scarce score (-0.43, -0.36 contribution), but unreliable (0/20 spot check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.49 SD, -0.35 contribution) opposes stromal invasion · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · High score (1.10, -0.25 contribution) supports non-invasive stroma · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (diff +0.001, CI -0.009 to 0.006); mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3, 100th OOD percentile) masks a benign lesion (9% probability, contrast BACH_0027) or focal atypia.
- Reliability score (96%) misses blur-induced error (dataset AUROC 0.70, n=1716), and HoVer-Net cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8**: Inspect highest-risk tile (0.002) to confirm benign stroma and fat without stromal invasion.
2. **Region 3**: Check ducts and superior-lateral margin corner (22% segment probability) for blurred atypia.
3. **Regions 1, 7, 11**: Verify whether lymphocytic infiltrate reflects normal tissue or benign lesion (BACH_0027 contrast).
